Project Progress Report & Complete System Guide

Study Corner MNL — Offline POS & Financial Ledger

1943 Rd 5 Sta. Mesa / San Marcelino Ermita, Manila • Operating Hours: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM

1. Project Progress Summary & Offline-First Upgrade

The Study Corner POS & Ledger System is built for Desktop PC, Tablet, and Smartphone, fully tested (12/12 automated test suites passing), and equipped with Hybrid Offline-First Caching & Browser LocalStorage so the shop can operate 100% offline without interruption.

Offline Caching & Browser LocalStorage (Completed)

  • PWA Service Worker (sw.js): Caches the app shell, scripts, styles, official logo, and QR code images in browser CacheStorage for instant offline page loads.
  • Full LocalStorage Database (sc_pos_state_v1): Stores active timers, visits, sales receipts, food menu, customer memberships, study plans, shifts, and settings locally in the browser.
  • Auto-Sync Outbox Queue (sc_pos_outbox_v1): Queues any transaction recorded while offline and syncs automatically when the local SQLite Hub is reachable.
  • Client-Side CSV & JSON Backups: Generate Sales CSV, Payments CSV, Expenses CSV, and full JSON backups directly from the browser even when offline.

Distilled UI across Desktop, Tablet & Phone + SQLite Hub

  • Clarity Over Density: Clean light top header, flat session cards with tabular numerals, single-column check-in with inline member/plan autocomplete, and unified 4-column financial summary strip.
  • Built-In Multi-Device Preview Studio: Launch /?preview=devices from Settings → Sync & Backup to view Phone (390×760), Tablet (768×740), and Desktop (1280×720) layouts side-by-side.
  • SQLite Database & Monthly CSV Ledgers: Persistent local database (StudyCorner_Data/study_corner.sqlite) with automatic monthly CSV files and shift-close backups.
  • Real-Time Sync: Live updates across PC, Tablet, and Phone via Server-Sent Events (/api/events) and browser storage events.
